summary: Voters in Chandpur mostly talk about flood-hit villages and riverside isolation, district health and power gaps, and unpaid cane dues, with the town's rail links and station the main thing they appreciate.

positives.english: Floodwater has gone down and villagers got some relief
positives.hindi: गंगा का पानी उतरा है, गांवों को थोड़ी राहत मिली है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, 3 Aug 2026): Ganga's water level in the khadar area has fallen, bringing some relief to villagers. The same article says nine villages are still surrounded by water. District-level, not confirmed inside the AC.

positives.english: 137 health sub-centres in the district have got quality certificates
positives.hindi: जिले के 137 उपकेंद्रों को गुणवत्ता प्रमाण पत्र मिला है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jul 2026): Bijnor ranks 4th in the state and 1st in its division for NQAS certificates; 137 health sub-centres in the district have received the certificate, per CMO Dr. Kaushalendra Singh. District-level, not AC-specific.

positives.english: Mussoorie and Garhwal Express stop at Chandpur station
positives.hindi: चांदपुर स्टेशन पर मसूरी और गढ़वाल एक्सप्रेस रुकती हैं
positives.basis: Wikipedia (undated): Chandpur Siau station, Main Market, Chandpur, Bijnor; Mussoorie Express, Garhwal Express and Lucknow-Chandigarh Express stop there. Station is in Chandpur town (Chandpur MB), which the AC article lists among its areas.

positives.english: Trains to Delhi, Lucknow and Roorkee are available from Chandpur
positives.hindi: चांदपुर से दिल्ली, लखनऊ और रुड़की की ट्रेन मिल जाती है
positives.basis: Wikipedia (undated) on Chandpur town: says the town has rail links to places including New Delhi, Lucknow and Roorkee. The article's transport section is tagged as unsourced, so treat as weak. Town is inside the AC.

positives.english: Daily market and shops are close by in Chandpur town
positives.hindi: *चांदपुर में रोज़मर्रा की दुकानें और बाज़ार पास में मिल जाते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: no source found on Chandpur market facilities. Based only on the town being a municipal board (nagar palika parishad) with a population of 83,441 (2011 census, Wikipedia). Needs field check.

negatives.english: Nine villages are still surrounded by flood water, tractors are the only way out
negatives.hindi: बाढ़ के पानी से नौ गांव अब भी घिरे हैं, ट्रैक्टर ही सहारा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (3 Aug 2026), dateline Jaleelpur: even after water fell, the settlements of nine villages remain surrounded by water; bikes and cars cannot move on flooded roads and tractor-trolleys are the only way in and out; access roads Siyali-Dattiyana, Siyali-Sujatpur Khadar, Muzaffarpur Khadar-Dattiyana and Sujatpur Khadar-Dattiyana broken. Villages named (Dattiyana, Siyali, Kumariya, Raipur Khadar etc.) are in Ganga khadar, not confirmed inside the AC. District-level.

negatives.english: Power cuts and no diesel in the generator stop dialysis at the district hospital
negatives.hindi: बिजली कटती है, जनरेटर में डीजल नहीं, डायलिसिस रुक जाता है
negatives.basis: Quint Hindi (22 Jun 2025): at Bijnor district hospital a 26-year-old patient's dialysis was interrupted by power cuts and a shortage of diesel for the generator; his mother said the generator had no diesel for about a month; DM Jasjeet Kaur acknowledged there was no such arrangement. District-level (district hospital, Bijnor city), not inside the AC.

negatives.english: Sugar mills have cane money pending and farmers are still waiting
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिलों पर गन्ने का बकाया है, किसानों का पैसा अटका है
negatives.basis: The Quint (27 Sep 2019, old): farmers in Bijnor district claim around nine sugar mills owe some Rs 500 crore, with dues unpaid since 2018; the report says the district cane officer threatened FIRs. Mills not named; district-level and dated 2019, so verify current status.

negatives.english: Our village has only one primary school, children go to other towns to study
negatives.hindi: गांव में बस एक प्राथमिक स्कूल है, बच्चे दूसरे कस्बों में पढ़ने जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Wikipedia (Chelapur, census 2001 population 644): only one primary school in the village, so parents send children to nearby towns and cities such as Noorpur and Dhampur. AC membership unconfirmed: Chelapur is in Chandpur tehsil but is not in the AC article's listed areas. Data is old.

negatives.english: No drain in our village, drain water goes straight into water bodies
negatives.hindi: गांव में नाली नहीं है, नाली का पानी सीधे जल स्रोतों में जाता है
negatives.basis: onefivenine village directory (auto-generated, census-linked, undated): Basera is in Chandpur tehsil; 'No Drainage System Available in this Village'; 'Drain water is discharged directly into water bodies.' AC membership unconfirmed. Directory entry, not news; needs verification.

notes: Local coverage for Chandpur AC was very thin: over 30 Hindi and English searches (Amar Ujala, Dainik Jagran, Patrika, Quint, Aaj Tak, Gaon Connection, police and tender pages) found no news report that names Chandpur town or any village inside the AC for roads, water, drainage, power, sugar mill or hospital problems. Most negatives are district-level (Bijnor), so they are not AC-specific; ac_specific_negatives is 0 and a field check is strongly needed. Two negatives (Chelapur, Basera) are village items with AC membership unconfirmed; their data is from 2001/2011 census-era directories. The sugar-dues item is from 2019 and must be re-checked for current status. Positive 5 is an inference with no source. Excluded: Patrika 27 Aug 2018 flood article (Najibabad/Kachhiyana, old, outside AC); Aaj Tak 10 Sep 2025 Ganga embankment erosion (Bijnor barrage, no AC village named); a Chandpur tender for drain and road repair in Nagar Palika Parishad Chandpur ward 11 (only seen on an aggregator, original page returned 403, not cited); Wikipedia's Ganga 20 km claim (marked as needing citation). AC incumbent per Wikipedia: Swami Omvesh (Samajwadi Party, elected 2022), not used as political content. Suggested field check: Chandpur town municipal drains and roads, Chandpur Siau station, Chandpur CHC, Ganga khadar villages, and the nearest sugar mill to Chandpur.
